# Item Types

<!-- Generated by scripts/bundle-schemas.mjs from schemas/. Do not edit: change the schemas and run it again. -->

What each type of overlay, annotation and library resource is for, and what its `frametrail:attributes` hold. The source is the JSON Schemas in [`schemas/attributes/`](../schemas/attributes/); [DATA-MODEL.md](DATA-MODEL.md) explains the items these attributes belong to.

## At a Glance

| Type | Overlay | Annotation | Library | What it is |
|------|:-------:|:----------:|:-------:|------------|
| `text` | ✓ | ✓ |  | Text overlay or annotation: rich text with an optional title and card style, for titles, captions, notes and explanations. |
| `html` | ✓ | ✓ |  | Custom HTML overlay or annotation, for what the other types cannot show. |
| `quiz` | ✓ | ✓ |  | Quiz overlay or annotation: a question with answers to choose (scored), or asking for a free text or a rating, to check understanding at a point in the video. |
| `hotspot` | ✓ |  |  | Hotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) that marks something in the picture and can open a URL or jump to a time or another hypervideo, or a drawn mark (arrow, underline, freeform outline) that points something out. |
| `cursor` | ✓ |  |  | Cursor overlay: a mouse pointer with click ripples, for walking through a screen recording. |
| `counter` | ✓ |  |  | Counter overlay: a number that counts up or rolls like an odometer, for a figure or statistic the video mentions. |
| `chart` | ✓ |  |  | Chart overlay: an animated bar, line or donut chart, or a progress ring, for numbers the video talks about. |
| `image` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Image: a picture, diagram or photo. |
| `video` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Video file (MP4, WebM or HLS) shown over or beside the hypervideo's own video. |
| `audio` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Audio file with player controls: narration, music, a sound clip. |
| `pdf` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | PDF document in a viewer: a handout, a paper, slides. |
| `youtube` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | YouTube video. |
| `vimeo` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Vimeo video. |
| `wistia` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Wistia video. |
| `loom` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Loom video. |
| `twitch` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Twitch video or live channel. |
| `soundcloud` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | SoundCloud track or playlist. |
| `spotify` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Spotify track, album, playlist or podcast. |
| `webpage` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Web page shown in an iframe, or as a card when the site forbids embedding. |
| `wikipedia` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Wikipedia article summary, for background on a term, a person or an event. |
| `entity` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Linked data entity, such as a Wikidata item: a person, place or concept with its description. |
| `location` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Map (OpenStreetMap via Leaflet) centred on a coordinate, for a place the video shows or mentions. |
| `mastodon` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Mastodon post. |
| `codepen` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | CodePen embed: a live HTML, CSS and JavaScript demo. |
| `figma` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Figma embed: a design file or prototype. |
| `urlpreview` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Link preview card: title, description and image of a page, or the platform's own embed for posts from Bluesky, X, TikTok, SlideShare, Reddit and Flickr. |

Overlay: an item of `hypervideo.json` → `contents`, shown over the video. Annotation: an item of a user's annotation file. Library: a resource of `resources/_index.json`, which overlays and annotations can be made from. The type is the body's `frametrail:type`.

## Every Overlay

Every overlay type also takes these attributes; annotations do not use them.

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `opacity` | number | 0–1 | `1` | Opacity of the overlay. |
| `hoverStyle` | object |  |  | How the overlay changes on hover. Missing means it does not change. |
| `hoverStyle.opacity` | number | 0–1 | `0.85` | Opacity while hovered. |
| `hoverStyle.scale` | number |  | `1.05` | Scale while hovered. |
| `hoverStyle.borderColor` | string |  |  | CSS border colour while hovered. Empty means none. |
| `hoverStyle.backgroundColor` | string |  |  | CSS background colour while hovered. Empty means none. |
| `zIndex` | integer | ≥ 0 |  | Stacking order among the hypervideo's overlays (0 = bottom). Missing means creation order. |
| `animation` | object |  |  | Overlay animation. Transitions frame the time span: the overlay is fully present and clickable for exactly [start, end]. Missing phases have no animation. Replaces the legacy animationIn / animationOut / animationDuration attributes on the first edit in the Animation tab. See [Animation](#animation). |
| `animationIn` | string | `fade`, `slideLeft`, `slideRight`, `slideUp`, `slideDown`, `zoom` |  | Legacy. Entrance of overlays saved before the Animation tab existed, mapped to animation.in when read. Ignored when animation is present. |
| `animationOut` | string | `fade`, `slideLeft`, `slideRight`, `slideUp`, `slideDown`, `zoom` |  | Legacy. Exit of overlays saved before the Animation tab existed, mapped to animation.out when read. Ignored when animation is present. |
| `animationDuration` | number or string |  | `300` | Legacy. Duration of animationIn and animationOut in milliseconds. |

## Types

### `text`

Text overlay or annotation: rich text with an optional title and card style, for titles, captions, notes and explanations. Over a busy picture a card (box) keeps the text readable.

Overlay, annotation. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/text.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/text.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string |  | `""` | The text. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("&lt;p&gt;Hello&lt;/p&gt;"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering. |
| `title` | string |  |  | Optional title, plain text, shown above the text. |
| `box` | object |  |  | Card style. Missing means the text is drawn without a card. |
| `box.background` | string |  | `transparent` | CSS background colour. |
| `box.titleColor` | string |  |  | CSS colour of the title. |
| `box.padding` | number | ≥ 0 |  | Padding in pixels. |
| `box.radius` | number | ≥ 0 |  | Corner radius in pixels. |
| `box.borderWidth` | number | ≥ 0 | `0` | Border width in pixels. 0 means no border. |
| `box.borderColor` | string |  | `#000000` | CSS border colour. |
| `box.shadow` | boolean |  | `false` | Draw a drop shadow. |

### `html`

Custom HTML overlay or annotation, for what the other types cannot show. Not sanitised.

Overlay, annotation. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/html.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/html.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string |  | `""` | The HTML source. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("&lt;p&gt;Hello&lt;/p&gt;"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering. |

### `quiz`

Quiz overlay or annotation: a question with answers to choose (scored), or asking for a free text or a rating, to check understanding at a point in the video. A quiz overlay made in the editor pauses the video when it appears (frametrail:events onStart). Scored question types use onCorrectAnswer and onWrongAnswer, the others onAnswered.

Overlay, annotation. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/quiz.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/quiz.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `questionType` | string | `multipleChoice`, `multiSelect`, `freeText`, `rating` | `multipleChoice` | multipleChoice: one answer, scored. multiSelect: several answers, scored on submit. freeText: a text response, not scored. rating: a numeric scale, not scored. |
| `question` | string |  |  | The question, plain text. |
| `answers` | array of objects |  |  | multipleChoice and multiSelect: the answers. |
| `answers[].text` | string |  |  | Required. Answer text, plain text. |
| `answers[].correct` | boolean |  | `false` | Whether this answer is correct. |
| `onCorrectAnswer` | object |  |  | multipleChoice and multiSelect: what happens after a correct answer. |
| `onCorrectAnswer.showText` | string or boolean |  | `false` | Text shown in a dialog after answering. false means none. |
| `onCorrectAnswer.resumePlayback` | boolean |  | `true` | Resume playback after answering. |
| `onCorrectAnswer.jumpForward` | number or boolean |  | `false` | Seconds to jump forward after answering. false or 0 means no jump. |
| `onWrongAnswer` | object |  |  | multipleChoice and multiSelect: what happens after a wrong answer. |
| `onWrongAnswer.showText` | string or boolean |  | `false` | Text shown in a dialog after answering. false means none. |
| `onWrongAnswer.resumePlayback` | boolean |  | `true` | Resume playback after answering. |
| `onWrongAnswer.jumpBackward` | number or boolean |  | `10` | Seconds to jump back after answering. false or 0 means no jump. |
| `onAnswered` | object |  |  | freeText and rating: what happens after answering. |
| `onAnswered.showText` | string or boolean |  | `false` | Text shown in a dialog after answering. false means none. |
| `onAnswered.resumePlayback` | boolean |  | `true` | Resume playback after answering. |
| `ratingScale` | integer | 2–10 | `5` | rating: number of steps. |

### `hotspot`

Hotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) that marks something in the picture and can open a URL or jump to a time or another hypervideo, or a drawn mark (arrow, underline, freeform outline) that points something out. Overlay only. A plain hotspot made in the editor pauses the video when it appears (frametrail:events onStart); the drawn marks do not.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/hotspot.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/hotspot.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `shape` | string | `circle`, `rectangle`, `rounded`, `arrow`, `underline`, `freeform` | `circle` | The shape. |
| `color` | string |  | `#0096ff` | CSS colour of the outline or line. |
| `borderWidth` | number | ≥ 0 | `5` | Outline or line width in percent of the smaller side of the box. |
| `borderRadius` | number | ≥ 0 | `10` | rounded only: corner radius in pixels. |
| `backgroundColor` | string |  | `""` | CSS fill colour. Set, it hides the pulse ring so the hotspot reads as a button. Empty means no fill. |
| `text` | string |  | `""` | Label inside the hotspot, plain text. |
| `textColor` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS colour of the label. |
| `direction` | string | `right`, `left`, `up`, `down`, `upRight`, `upLeft`, `downRight`, `downLeft` | `right` | arrow only: where the arrow points. |
| `curve` | string | `straight`, `curved`, `swoop` | `straight` | arrow only: straight, curved (one bend) or swoop (S-like). |
| `points` | array of objects |  |  | freeform only: the outline as points in 0–100 box coordinates. Smooth points let the outline curve through them, the others are corners. |
| `points[].x` | number |  |  | Required. Horizontal position in percent of the box. |
| `points[].y` | number |  |  | Required. Vertical position in percent of the box. |
| `points[].smooth` | boolean |  | `false` | Curve through this point instead of a corner. |
| `path` | string |  |  | freeform only: the outline as an SVG path in 0–100 box coordinates. Derived from points and written for other consumers; a shape that has only a path (older data) is drawn from it and converted to points on its first edit. |
| `linkUrl` | string |  |  | Legacy. URL opened on click, from before the action model. Treated as action "openUrl" when action is empty. |
| `action` | string | `""`, `openUrl`, `jumpToTime`, `jumpToHypervideo` |  | What a click does. Empty means nothing (custom code goes into the overlay's onClick event). |
| `actionTarget` | string or number |  |  | Target of the action: a URL for openUrl (one starting with # changes the page hash), seconds of the video for jumpToTime, a hypervideo id for jumpToHypervideo. |
| `actionTargetTime` | number or string |  |  | jumpToHypervideo only: the time in seconds to start the target hypervideo at. Empty or 0 means its start. |

### `cursor`

Cursor overlay: a mouse pointer with click ripples, for walking through a screen recording. Overlay only. It moves along the overlay's keyframes (box motion) and clicks at the times in clicks.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/cursor.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/cursor.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `style` | string | `arrow`, `hand` | `arrow` | Pointer glyph. |
| `color` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS fill colour of the pointer and its ripples. |
| `outlineColor` | string |  | `#111111` | CSS outline colour of the pointer. |
| `clicks` | array of numbers or string |  | `[]` | Click times in seconds from the overlay's start. A string of numbers separated by commas, semicolons or spaces is read as well. |

### `counter`

Counter overlay: a number that counts up or rolls like an odometer, for a figure or statistic the video mentions. Overlay only.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/counter.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/counter.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `from` | number |  | `0` | Start value. |
| `to` | number |  | `100` | End value. |
| `decimals` | integer | 0–4 | `0` | Decimal places. |
| `prefix` | string |  | `""` | Text before the number. |
| `suffix` | string |  | `""` | Text after the number. |
| `style` | string | `count`, `roll` | `count` | count: the value counts up. roll: the digits roll like an odometer. |
| `duration` | number | ≥ 0 | `1500` | Duration of the count in milliseconds, from the overlay's start. |
| `ease` | string | an ease, see [Eases](#eases) |  | Easing of the count. Default power2Out. |
| `color` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS text colour. |
| `weight` | number |  | `700` | CSS font weight. |
| `align` | string | `left`, `center`, `right` | `center` | Horizontal alignment. |

### `chart`

Chart overlay: an animated bar, line or donut chart, or a progress ring, for numbers the video talks about. Overlay only. The values are lines of text ("Label: value") in data.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/chart.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/chart.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `chartType` | string | `bars`, `line`, `donut`, `ring` | `bars` | Kind of chart. |
| `data` | string |  | `""` | One "Label: value" per line ("=" works too); a line with only a number has an empty label. The ring uses the first value as a percentage. Grouping separators and a decimal comma are understood. |
| `unit` | string |  | `""` | Text after each value, e.g. "%". |
| `color` | string |  | `#4cc3ff` | CSS colour of the bars, line or segments. |
| `textColor` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS colour of labels and values. |
| `highlight` | integer | ≥ -1 | `-1` | Index of the item drawn highlighted. -1 means none. |
| `showValues` | boolean |  | `true` | Show the values. |
| `duration` | number | ≥ 0 | `1500` | Duration of the build-up in milliseconds, from the overlay's start. |

### `image`

Image: a picture, diagram or photo. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/image.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/image.schema.json).

No attributes of its own.

### `video`

Video file (MP4, WebM or HLS) shown over or beside the hypervideo's own video. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL. A video overlay can play along with the hypervideo while it is shown (autoPlay).

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/video.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/video.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `autoPlay` | boolean |  | `false` | Overlays only: play in sync with the hypervideo while the overlay is active. |
| `alternateVideoFile` | string |  |  | Legacy. A second rendition of the video file. Not read. |

### `audio`

Audio file with player controls: narration, music, a sound clip. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL. An audio overlay can play along with the video while it is shown (autoPlay).

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/audio.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/audio.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `autoPlay` | boolean |  | `false` | Overlays only: play in sync with the hypervideo while the overlay is active. |

## Animation

Overlay animation. Transitions frame the time span: the overlay is fully present and clickable for exactly [start, end]. Missing phases have no animation. Replaces the legacy animationIn / animationOut / animationDuration attributes on the first edit in the Animation tab. Every overlay takes it as its `animation` attribute.

| Phase | What it is | Presets |
|-------|------------|---------|
| `in` | Entrance. It plays before the overlay's start (lead-in), clipped at the start of the video. | `fadeIn`, `slideFromLeft`, `slideFromRight`, `slideFromTop`, `slideFromBottom`, `zoomIn`, `popIn`, `blurIn`, `wipeFromLeft`, `wipeFromRight`, `wipeFromTop`, `wipeFromBottom`, `irisIn`, `dropIn`, `rotateIn`, `draw` |
| `emphasis` | Loop that plays within the overlay's time span. | `pulse`, `breathe`, `wobble`, `shake`, `bounce`, `float`, `heartbeat`, `flash`, `glow` |
| `out` | Exit. It plays after the overlay's end (trail-out). | `fadeOut`, `slideToLeft`, `slideToRight`, `slideToTop`, `slideToBottom`, `zoomOut`, `popOut`, `blurOut`, `wipeToLeft`, `wipeToRight`, `wipeToTop`, `wipeToBottom`, `irisOut`, `dropOut`, `rotateOut`, `undraw` |
| `text` | Text reveal (text overlays), within the span. | `fadeUp`, `fade`, `pop`, `blurIn`, `slideIn`, `typewriter`, `marker` |

Each phase is an object:

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `preset` | string | the phase's presets, above |  | Required. Id of the preset. |
| `duration` | number | ≥ 0 |  | Duration in milliseconds. Missing means the preset's own duration. |
| `ease` | string | an ease, see [Eases](#eases) |  | Easing. Missing means the preset's own easing. |
| `params` | object |  |  | Parameters some animation presets use. |
| `params.distance` | number | 0–100 | `5` | Travel distance of slide, drop, shake, bounce, float and glow, in percent of the smaller side of the video stage. |
| `params.color` | string |  |  | CSS colour of glow and marker. |
| `iterations` | integer | ≥ 0 | `0` | `emphasis` only: how often the loop plays. 0 fills the span. |
| `mode` | string | `word`, `letter` |  | `text` only: reveal word by word or letter by letter. Missing means the preset's own mode, or word. |
| `stagger` | number | ≥ 0 |  | `text` only: delay between words or letters in milliseconds. |

### Eases

Id of an easing function. The animation phases take one, as do keyframes (the segment to the next keyframe) and the `counter` type.

`linear`, `hold`, `ease`, `easeIn`, `easeOut`, `easeInOut`, `gentleOut`, `power1In`, `power1Out`, `power1InOut`, `power2In`, `power2Out`, `power2InOut`, `power3In`, `power3Out`, `power3InOut`, `power4In`, `power4Out`, `power4InOut`, `sineIn`, `sineOut`, `sineInOut`, `expoIn`, `expoOut`, `expoInOut`, `circIn`, `circOut`, `circInOut`, `backIn`, `backOut`, `backInOut`, `springGentle`, `springQuick`, `springBouncy`, `springSlow`, `wiggle`, `wiggleBounce`
